bullets.title: Rush
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Rush-Chris-Hemsworth/dp/B00H967074/), [Apple TV](https://itunes.apple.com/us/movie/rush/id700911218?cmp=rt_where_to_watch), [Netflix](https://www.netflix.com/title/70253165)). My girlfriend recommended we watch this movie before F1 lands in Austin later this month. It exceeded all expectations. The characters are complex, the story is nearly unbelievable, and the cinematography is absolutely stunning. Here’s the description: “In the mid-1970s, charismatic English playboy James Hunt ([Chris Hemsworth](https://twitter.com/chrishemsworth)) and Austrian perfectionist Niki Lauda ([Daniel Brühl](https://www.instagram.com/thedanielbruhl/)) share an intense rivalry in Formula 1 racing. Driving vehicles that are little more than gas-filled, rolling bombs, Hunt and Lauda burn up the track, all the while pushing themselves to the breaking point of physical and mental endurance.”
